battle_state_contract.field_rule: Every field declared here has exactly one storage classification. Unknown lifecycle payload inside a mutable store uses a separately typed opaque slot; uncertain state is never a derived cache by convenience. New fields must be classified and included before use.

reset.inputs: Immutable source/initial-state spec plus explicitly selected mode/profile
reset.preconditions: All required initialization/activation/terminal/RNG/state bindings pass gates; source-known definitions are insufficient.
reset.outputs: Fresh validated state or structured rejection
reset.writes: Replace the complete state atomically only on success; deterministic initial allocator and RNG states. No hidden native reset/lifecycle calls.
reset.blocked: Unproved native loadout/spawn/global setup or per-field reset prevents executable reset; inspection snapshot may still be constructed.

legal_actions.inputs: Published state and supported scheduler decision context
legal_actions.outputs: COMPLETE_FOR_SUPPORTED_SCOPE with PlayerLegalAction descriptors, or BLOCKED with exact reasons; never unknown-as-empty
legal_actions.reads: Actor/skill/resource/manual target and request-phase gates plus all dependencies
legal_actions.writes: None, including RNG, queues and authoritative lazy resolver state
legal_actions.rule: Ordinary candidate visibility is not legal action enumeration; native AI and special requests do not become player choices.

step.inputs: Published state, revision-bound action intent and explicit evidence profile
step.outputs: Atomically committed next state/events or rejection with identical pre-state and RNG

is_terminal.inputs: Published terminal state and explicit terminal-rule contract
is_terminal.outputs: Known result or BLOCKED_UNRESOLVED_TERMINAL, not false as an unknown default
is_terminal.writes: None; no auto-advance or official enemy-count inference

clone.outputs: Independent mutable stores/RNG with the same logical identities, alias graph, order, pending work and opaque bytes
clone.rule: Share immutable definitions; do not rerun reset/registration/activation or allocate replacement logical IDs. Reject executable cloning of unavailable external state.

snapshot.outputs: Versioned lossless definitions-by-hash plus all authoritative/opaque fields and ordered pending work
snapshot.rule: Preserve absent/null/false/zero/empty, raw integer lexemes, duplicates and alias relations. Include contract/evidence/extension versions. Unknown payload is inspection-only if not sufficient for faithful restoration.

hash.outputs: Versioned local semantic digest plus executability status
hash.rule: Hash every decision-affecting immutable/mutable/opaque field and referenced immutable content digest. Never claim native hash compatibility or executable completeness from digest equality.

serialization_policy.maps: Canonical key encoding permitted for serialization of semantically unordered maps only; it never chooses execution order.
serialization_policy.ordered_collections: Preserve authored/runtime order including holes, nulls, duplicates, pending work and input sequence; do not sort by ID.
serialization_policy.numbers: Lossless integers/decimal lexemes and pinned arithmetic precision/rounding; never round uint64 hashes via IEEE-754. Nonfinite/unsupported values reject before execution.
serialization_policy.references: Type-tagged local logical identity, generation and source identity; maintain alias graph and distinguish definition/instance.
serialization_policy.omitted_fields: Only DERIVED_CACHE with verified pure rebuild and nonsemantic diagnostics. Any decision-affecting lazy cache becomes authoritative or opaque state.
serialization_policy.opaque: Include owner/type/version, presence, raw bytes or immutable payload reference plus digest, unresolved reason and evidence. Missing actual external state cannot be reconstructed by hashing its reason.
serialization_policy.trace: Decision-affecting counters/ledger cursors are state. Pure debug output may be excluded from semantic hash but stored in replay envelope; rejection diagnostics are outside BattleState.

reopen_policy.process: Record new evidence, affected blocker, exact scope and change proposal in a separately authorized phase; preserve this freeze/history. No automatic new Astra pass, broad reverse, recapture, fetch or whole-corpus compiler rerun.
reopen_policy.terra_permission: A later explicit Terra implementation request may implement safe tickets without reopening domains. It cannot authorize native guesses merely by choosing an extension or reference mode.
reopen_policy.stop: After final artifact validation, stop. No runtime implementation, new semantic domain or commit.

representations.SchedulerCandidate: Visible actor opportunity or per-family request; may be unresolved and not player-controllable.
representations.PlayerLegalAction: Revision/profile-bound actor+skill+manual TargetIntent+resource plan with closed input/target/effect/consumption gates.
representations.AIDecisionOpportunity: Scheduler-supplied actor/context only; policy leaves never directly become legal player actions.
representations.TargetIntent: Explicit selected primary target or symbolic selector with provenance; not an already-valid hit list.
representations.ManualTargetLegality: Separate bound candidate domain, flags/cardinality and stale-reference handling; unknown is blocked, not illegal.
representations.AutomaticSecondaryTargets: Resolved under independent selector/order/cardinality contracts; never offered as manual choices by default.
representations.InsertedSpecialAction: Own request/admission/arbitration/consumption contract; not a player action solely because visible or ready.

legal_actions_contract.current_native_boundary: No generic native legal_actions implementation is justified. Pure supported-scope legality infrastructure may be implemented; all uncertain admission/resource/target/activation dependencies return BLOCKED with reasons.
legal_actions_contract.reference_subset: Explicit ordinary current living player; Normal/BPSkill with supplied bp_need/bp_add, cap and exact input targets under selected ordinary reference profile. No native static-tag, alive/team shortcut or automatic all-owned-skill expansion.
legal_actions_contract.ordinary_ultra: Historical energy predicate can be evaluated in a reference query; readiness does not enqueue/execute Ultra. Core excludes Ultra until a separately named caller-selected action mechanism and all dependencies are closed.
legal_actions_contract.blocked_list_policy: Return completeness status and per-candidate blockers. A partial representational candidate list must not masquerade as exhaustive PlayerLegalAction[]; missing semantics is never silently an empty legal list.

phases.rule: Use immutable published revision, explicit action and mode/profile; reject stale action/revision.

Pure dependency closure before any battle mutation, RNG draw, ID allocation or queue write. Validate payloads, numeric domains, identity/context, targets/cardinality/order, formulas/resources, callbacks/lifecycles, scheduler consumption and scenario/terminal dependencies.

Evaluate only supported pure deterministic predicates on read-only state or symbolic values. If a future branch/effect depends on unresolved semantics, conservatively include all possibly executed/registered dependencies. Never run battle effects or RNG to find out whether a blocker matters. Require bounded effect footprint for loops/callbacks/reentrancy.
Bind complete effect plan, allowed reads/writes, evidence refs and mode to input/state/contract revisions. Reject any UNKNOWN obligation; there is no trust-the-caller-native override.

Only after complete semantic closure, evaluate the closed plan into private next-state/delta and transaction-owned RNG. Readers still see original state; stage events/queues and allocator writes as well.
Validate final invariants and unchanged source revision; atomically publish all subsystem writes, RNG state/draw ledger and queued events together.

Preflight semantic rejection performs no speculative work. Unexpected evaluator/commit failure discards private state/RNG/event/allocator delta; no externally visible partial effects. Such failure is not coverage success.

step_transaction_contract.no_rollback_inference: Atomic publication is a sandbox design requirement. It establishes no native rollback, event cancellation or retry behavior. A private simulation is not permission to explore unknown semantics.
step_transaction_contract.external_effects: None inside execution. Diagnostic failure records may be emitted outside BattleState; no callbacks with external side effects before commit.
acceptance_tests: Each blocker placed after a supported effect in source order still rejects before the first effect.
Unsupported secondary target/event/global/terminal dependency blocks action before resource debit.
Unknown random branch rejects with identical RNG state and draw count.
Abort at every staged write preserves original state/hash/allocator/queues and discards staged draws.
Revision mismatch rejects and does not auto-retry a consumed action.

minimum_viable_faithful_core.meaning: Smallest deterministic kernel faithful to its evidence boundaries. It does not yet provide a native-faithful complete playable battle.

native_profile.accepts: Lossless definitions and state, typed identity, snapshots/hash, gate diagnostics, pure bound modifier lookup/transition plans and target leaf/consumer primitives.
native_profile.complete_battle_actions: NONE established end-to-end by this audit; source activation, action boundary and official terminal cannot be fabricated.

reference_profile.actions: Caller supplies exact ordinary actor/skill/entrypoint/context and closed Normal/BPSkill legality/resource/effect/completion contracts; no native AI selection, Ultra, insert, extra, follow-up, OneMore or interrupts.
reference_profile.scheduler: Only explicit eligible living ordinary participants in prior action list; property38 separate from behavior delay; positive speed; successful matching action task and settled effects/resources; no pending special arbitration. Stable prior-list tie reference only.
reference_profile.targets: Explicit ordered target refs with bound null/cardinality/validity contract. No random/aggro/adjacency/automatic retarget/boss proxy or implicit target revalidation.
reference_profile.damage: Exact existing normal ByAttack/ByMaxHP/ByDefence request with all factors supplied, deterministic explicit crit factor/no RNG, selected shield-before-HP and optional explicit HP-then-toughness/conditional Break reference. Exact isolated DOT no-crit tick allowed; no application/refresh/tick scheduler inference.
reference_profile.modifiers: Known read-only instance values and pure local lookup/decision plans. New core excludes source Add/refresh/global/remove lifecycle; exact self mark-removal may be used only as an isolated supplied-instance reference component, never inferred cleanup.
reference_profile.values_and_heal: Explicit-scope supported DynamicValue arithmetic/property reads; exact selected ordinary heal with supplied factors/living target and no unclosed listener.
reference_profile.scenario: Explicit initialized sandbox participant state; caller-selected extension terminal rule required for runnable custom session; official scenario setup/advance absent.
reference_profile.reject: Any unsupported state-dependent source, unknown context/default/order/lifecycle, random crit/target, unclosed callback or downstream terminal/transition dependency rejects whole step before writes/draws.
reference_profile.accounting: Reference and extension outputs carry mode/profile IDs; native-faithful executed coverage remains unclaimed.

minimum_viable_faithful_core.expansion: Add only independently scoped gates and regression evidence. No content-name switches, fallback algorithms or full-engine ticket.
